description: Optimized AM11 chord transmission — clean, full fidelity

notes.why_FM: FM capture effect rejects weak interference; wideband FM at 75 kHz deviation matches broadcast standard
notes.why_high_power: 500 W at 2 km gives ~96 dB SNR via Friis — thermal noise inaudible
notes.why_44100: Native WAV rate avoids resampling artifacts on the Am11 harmonics (up to D4 = 294 Hz + overtones)
notes.why_low_noise_floor: -120 dBm is achievable with a good LNA front-end; pushes SNR well above 40 dB threshold
